div.div: 4 اوعز إِلَيْهِ فِى كَذَا , (S, K,) or بِكَذَا, (Mgh,) inf. n. إِيعَازٌ, (Mgh, TA,) He commanded, ordered, or enjoined, him, respecting such a thing, syn. تقدّم, (S, Mgh, K,) and أَمَرَ, (Mgh, K,) أَنْ يَفْعَلَ أَوْ يَتْرُكَ that he should do [it] or not do [it]; (K;) as also اليه ↓ وعّز , (S, K *) inf .n تَوْعِيزٌ; (S;) and (sometimes S) اليه ↓ وَعَزَ , (S, K, *) inf. n. وَعْزٌ; (S;) which are also explained by قَدَّمَ [signifying the same as تَقَدَّمَ and أَمَرَ]: or the first and second are correct, accord. to ISk, but the last (وَعَزَ) is not allowable, accord. to him, nor is it, as related by AHát, accord. to As. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
